Design and sample: Exploratory artifact analysis and survey of nine organizations
Contribution to this review: Collaboration, security requirements, and shared practices help explain adoption
Limitation and resulting research need: Self-report and a small organizational sample do not establish breach reduction; evaluate behavior and outcomes longitudinally

Design and sample: Systematic mapping of 32 publications; collection completed in 2017
Contribution to this review: Half of the selected corpus concerns frameworks or tools, distinguishing proposals from evaluated outcomes
Limitation and resulting research need: Historical and search-dependent coverage cannot describe today’s field; repeat searches and compare evaluation maturity

Design and sample: Static-analysis study of 15,232 scripts from 293 open-source repositories
Contribution to this review: Recurring configuration weaknesses motivate automated inspection and contextual triage
Limitation and resulting research need: A smell is not a confirmed exploit; validate rules in additional languages and deployed contexts

Design and sample: Analysis of 5,110 Ansible-related defects, yielding eight categories
Contribution to this review: Execution-engine behavior can invalidate assumptions based only on approved configuration text
Limitation and resulting research need: Findings are tied to the investigated orchestrator; test state transitions and live effects in other systems

Design and sample: Five tools; 53 prescribed configurations; 544 files and 20 survey respondents
Contribution to this review: Reported precision and combined-tool recall reveal detection limitations despite tool availability
Limitation and resulting research need: Results depend on versions, rule mappings, and datasets; validate independently and reconcile source-version discrepancies
